title: Interior University Society - enamel pin artwork
description: Reconstructed flat vector artwork: five-sided chamfered body, warm orange enamel, black lettering, burgundy bars, and pale metal surrounds on individual letters and bars. The outlined Nimbus Sans Bold black inlays receive a separate +0.020-cap-height optical edge expansion (4.32-unit black outline at a 108-unit base cap), while the metal backing contours remain unchanged. This is a reconstruction adjustment, not an identified historical font cut. Photographic colours, metal finish and dimensions are uncalibrated. Nominal viewBox only, not a production die or certified manufacturing drawing.

title: Interior University Society - one-colour pin adaptation
description: Derived single-ink version of the reconstructed enamel pin, including the separately documented +0.020-cap-height optical black-edge adjustment. This reproduction adaptation is not asserted to be a surviving historical pin.

title: IUS pin - separate silhouette component
description: Editable five-sided geometric silhouette with rounded corners. Estimated proportions from photograph; not a measured cutline.

title: IUS three bars - separate graphic component
description: Three separately editable quadrilateral bars with a common right edge and 45-degree leading cuts. Source-print proportions. This is a component, not a separately documented historical standalone symbol.

title: Support Campaign - brochure wording
